title: Dog-Friendly 2BR Vacation Retreat on 30A with a Shared Pool
meta_description: Stay in this remodeled 2BR, 2.5BA 30A vacation rental that is dog-friendly with a balcony overlooking the communal pool, 2 blocks from the beach. Sleeps 6.
description_expanded: Come bask in the warm hues of sea and sand at Salty Paws Bungalow, a a newly remodeled 2-bedroom, 2.5-bathroom retreat for 6 guests and up to 2 doggies! This dog-friendly home is located in the Bungalows at Seagrove - just 2 blocks from the beach and has been completely renovated with fresh flooring, paint, and stylish decor. It's absolutely gorgeous and ready to welcome you for a relaxing stay!Salty Paws Bungalow offers convenience, charm and quality - not to mention a balcony overlooking the sparkling pool and spa. Unit 134 has a spacious, open living area downstairs, and both bedroom suites are upstairs. Beach days are carefree with a stay here - beach toys, beach chairs and a wagon to carry it all make trips to the shore a snap! There is custom storage built into the downstairs patio that houses all of the included beach gear.The downstairs features a dining room with seating for 6, plus an additional 3 guests can dine at the breakfast bar. The kitchen is fully-equipped with cooking supplies to make family dining a breeze. Guests will enjoy a convenient half bath downstairs was well as a full-sized washer and dryer. The living area features a large TV to keep the family entertained, and the home of course has free high-speed Wi-Fi to keep you connected.With a view of the pool area and palm trees, the upstairs balcony may be accessed from either bedroom and is an ideal spot for a cup of coffee in the morning or drinks in the evenings. Parking is just steps from the door, making Salty Paws one of the most conveniently-located units at the Bungalows. Bringing your furry friends? We've got you covered! We provide complimentary pet-friendly amenities, such as food/water bowls and 2 pet crates (medium and large). We love animals, but please note only dogs are allowed.Sleeping Arrangements:1st Floor: Sofa in living room pulls out to a queen bed2nd Floor, Bedroom 1: King bed, TV, balcony access. Private bathroom with tub and shower.2nd Floor, Bedroom 2: Queen bed, TV, balcony access. Private bathroom with shower.Beach Access:Head out the neighborhood and go south on Somerset Bridge Road. Directly across 30A at the Tom Thumb is your beach access.Distance: .3 miles | Time: 5 minutes walkingSeagrove Beach:Named for the thick grove of oak trees lining its coastline, Seagrove Beach is located in the heart of 30A. There's no better spot to experience everything 30A has to offer! Feeling adventurous? Visit famous Seaside and Grayton Beach State Park to the West. Head East and discover more of Seagrove Beach plus the wonderful coastal communities of Alys Beach and Rosemary Beach. Enjoy exploring the boutique shops, fabulous restaurants, and beautiful state parks in each of these communities.Your stay at Salty Paws Bungalow comes with Xplorie’s best activities! one ticket per day, per activity! (over $800 in nightly value) Tee off at Emerald Bay or Regatta Bay, zip through Baytowne Adventure Zone, and sail on the Sea Blaster Dolphin Cruise. Enjoy Big Kahuna’s Water Park, Black Light Mini Golf, and scenic bike rides with complimentary rentals. Explore 30A with ease and adventure!* Parking for 2 cars.* Benchmark cannot guarantee/service owner-provided amenities* Dog Friendly: If bringing a pet, an additional non-refundable pet fee will be added to your booking. Please contact us if you are bringing a dog. A maximum of 2 dogs is allowed. Please see our rental policies for further details.A Benchmark welcome bag and initial starter kit of amenities are provided for all guests. For the kitchen this includes: 1 roll of paper towels, 1 dish sponge, 1 dish soap, 2 dishwasher pods, and 1 liner for each trashcan. For each bathroom it includes: 1 roll of toilet paper, 1 set of soap/body wash/shampoo/conditioner/lotion. For towels you will receive: 1 body towel/1 washcloth per guest and 2 hand towels per bathroom, plus 2 washing machine pods.
